0022600007.text: The Nuggets open their season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, and both teams are still at 0-0, so this is a first look for each side. The last meeting went to Denver, a 127-107 Nuggets win in April, though the Thunder took three of the four head-to-head games last season. Spencer Jones is listed as day-to-day with a hamstring issue and is a game-time decision for Denver, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance to win.

0022600110.text: Both teams are still waiting to play their first games of the season, so this will be the first look at how they stack up in 2025-26. Denver leads the season series 3-0 from last year, and the most recent meeting was a 122-116 Nuggets win in New Orleans on January 14, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver an 80% chance to win.

0022600127.text: The Nuggets host the Golden State Warriors in a regular-season game, and the teams are 0-0 against each other this season after splitting their 2-2 series last season. Their most recent meeting was in Denver on March 30, when the Nuggets won 116-93. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out after knee surgery, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 70% chance to win.
